messages.author: e689753769140e98
messages.subject: Shiny 0.11.1 and tabPanel
parts:
Hi

I just installed shiny 0.11.1  and as soon as I try to use a navbarpage as below, I receive a error message in my browser : 

Error in buildTabset(tabs, "nav", NULL, id) :
  tabsetPanel doesn't have an id assigned, but one of its tabPanels has a value. The value won't be sent without an id.
 
The code that i trry :

ui.R

shinyUI(
    navbarPage("Example",
        tabPanel("DataTable",
            selectInput("dataset", label=h6("Dataset"), choices=c("mtcars","iris"), selected="mtcars", multiple=FALSE),
            #DT::dataTableOutput('tbl')
            dataTableOutput('tbl')
        )
    )
)

server.R

 function(input, output) {   
    dataset <- reactive({ d <- if(input$dataset=="mtcars") mtcars else iris; d })
    #output$tbl = DT::renderDataTable({ DT::datatable(dataset()) })
    output$tbl = renderDataTable({ dataset() })
}



 Someone has an idea of what goes wrong;

thank you very much

Alain

parts:
Sorry, that's a bug that's been fixed on master. Can you try upgrading?

if (!require(devtools))
  install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny")

Thanks and sorry for the inconvenience!
